TermAl operating model from 2026-10-10 about 23:45Z (Greg adopted it for Engram; Advisor b9d13887 #553 asked TermAl to apply it; Termal::Fable2's assessment in #554). CONTINUOUS PRODUCERS plus a SERIAL MECHANICAL MERGER.
- Producers (coders) prepare disjoint packages in isolated worktrees: implementation, RED/GREEN, freeze, and a clean review pair. Then they HAND OFF the item (engram handoff, or a release plus a note) with a package note: freeze, base, root, pair delegations, run ids, criteria changes. Then they start the next item. Producers no longer carry after every landing.
- The Merger is Termal::Opus2 (session-8111, the integration owner per CLAUDE.md). It claims the handed-off item, carries it onto current master (hunk-identical: no pair; merged or changed hunks: back to the coder for a confirmation pair or a fix), re-names the root ONCE, and gates on Fable2's LAUNCH NOW. Then it commits, evaluates with the turn held open, and lands and installs. Conflicts and gate failures go back to the coder.
- Why the handoff: a full gate is credited to the claim of the launching session, from a root named under that claim.
- Fable2 controls the queue, the gate alternation with Engram, review and evaluation rulings, and landing order.
- If Opus2 is down (Claude limits), a Codex session can stand in; the procedure is mechanical.
First packages: w-d3e97ac8a353 (Opus3), then w-539ea7e8b506 (BarA1), then w-cd57679e0bb6 (CSharpProof) and Codex's w-aec234e3f7d0 and w-b21c5132848c after their pairs. This grants no new authority; commit and push stay with the integration owner.

CONFIRMED by Engram::Advisor (b9d13887 #555, 23:43:56Z): "Proceed after w-49818 lands. The proposed handoff model is consistent with Greg's continuous producer/integrator direction: Opus2 is the serial TermAl Merger, carries only the approved package once onto current master, returns conflicts or changed hunks to the coder, and Fable2 retains queue/gate/review/evaluation order. Record the first two preflight packages as w-d3e97ac8a353 then w-539ea7e8b506."

CORRECTION by Greg (Advisor b9d13887 #556, 23:44:36Z), verbatim: "Greg corrects the role decision: do not designate Opus2 as the continuing TermAl Merger. Keep Opus2 on its current w-49818 gate only. Greg is creating a dedicated Termal::Merger; after it appears, route the mechanical carry/preflight queue to that session. Preserve the proposed package order, but wait for the dedicated worker before new handoffs." So the MERGER is a dedicated session, Termal::Merger (session id to be recorded when it appears), NOT Opus2. Opus2 stays integration owner for w-49818. Coders keep their claims and frozen trees, and write package notes, until Termal::Merger exists. Package order unchanged: w-d3e97ac8a353, then w-539ea7e8b506. Opus3 and BarA1 were told at 23:45Z to cancel any offer already made to Opus2.

MERGER CREATED (Advisor b9d13887 #557, 23:45:52Z): "Greg created Termal::Merger, session-11865 … dedicated low-cost mechanical worker. Keep Opus2 on current w-49818 only. After that landing, hand Termal::Merger w-d3e97ac8a353, then w-539ea7e8b506, with source freeze, current-master base, prescribed checks and an explicit slot." The Merger is session-11865. Each handoff from Fable2 to the Merger names: the item, the coder, the source freeze and its base, the current-master base to carry onto, the prescribed checks (carry classification, freeze recompute, a single re-name, basis line), and the explicit gate slot.

Termal::Merger (session-11865) is onboarded (mailbox 92f3490a #2, 23:46:39Z): runtime Codex (GPT-6). It has read CLAUDE.md and the six memories, and it waits for an explicit first-package handoff and slot. It is not a Claude session, so the Claude weekly limit doesn't stop it. Onboarding brief: mailbox 92f3490a #1.

MERGER QUEUE at 00:10Z on 2026-10-11: (1) w-d3e97ac8a353, ACCEPTED by the Merger (claim 01a1266d, fence 3), carrying onto be2ed177; (2) w-539ea7e8b506 (BarA1, freeze c4e3ca80 on 36a0ca7f, note 80fd2629); (3) w-cd57679e0bb6 (CSharpProof, 071bd55c on 36a0ca7f, package note written); (4) w-aec234e3f7d0 (Codex, 8d6fcd87 on be2ed177, pair clean at 00:08Z); (5) w-462f66675bb4 (BarA2, 782bb756 on 7f6281da; BarA2's status unknown). Not yet ready: Codex's Resume w-b21c (new Medium), Opus3's w-5a1a, BarA1's w-b201, CSharpProof's w-668765e67e02, Opus2's w-a0ccc98f08e5.

MERGER QUEUE at 00:23Z (reported to Greg, Advisor b9d13887 #572): 1. w-d3e9 (Merger, carried clean, new freeze 0b6e2a38 on be2ed177, re-name pending); 2. w-539e (BarA1, c4e3ca80 on 36a0ca7f); 3. w-5a1a (Opus3, freeze 756a0cc5 on be2ed177, pair clean; the last w-58cf child); 4. w-cd57 (CSharpProof); 5. w-aec234 (Codex, 8d6fcd87); then w-b201 (BarA1, 047a99d3, pair running) and w-462 (BarA2). Ordering rule: w-668765 (CSharpProof) is rebuilt ON TOP of w-539e after w-539e lands (shared hunks in acceptance_evaluation_api.rs and engram_source_roots.rs). Lesson: the Merger ended a turn after carrying without mailing me, so ask it to always end with a "ready for X" mail.

FREEZE KIND RULE (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-11 01:26Z, after w-4cdb's handoff mismatch). A package handed to the Merger names its freeze as the Engram schema-1 review-freeze fingerprint, which is what the Merger recomputes, labelled with its kind, plus the staged blob ids. A launcher composite (captureFingerprint) may be added only when labelled as one. w-4cdb was handed over with the composite b22eed66; the Merger's schema-1 recompute (a2be1050) correctly refused it until Opus2 proved the reviewed blob edb2bee5 was the staged one. Producers: state the kind; the Merger: on a mismatch, compare the blob ids before anything else.

QUEUE at 2026-10-11 01:57Z (Termal::Fable2). w-4cdb gated PASS (test-09d68888) and is being committed by the Merger; Opus2 pushes. Then: w-d3e9 (the Merger holds it; carry onto the new master and regate), w-539e (BarA1), w-5a1a (Opus3), w-2d69 (Opus3, P1 of w-df1e; pair clean), w-8375 (Opus3, P3 drift re-audit, test-only, pair clean round 3), w-cd57 (CSharpProof), w-aec234 (Codex, 8d6fcd87), Resume w-b21c (Codex; GREEN passed, fresh pair pending), w-b201 (BarA1; diagnostics running), w-462 (BarA2). Active P1 work under Greg's transient-recovery direction: w-cfcf10b68c9b (CSharpProof; RED recorded test-99ca7d93) and w-8f9a11d3600c (Opus3). w-a0cc (Opus2) waits for a cold-build slot after Engram's gate.
